summary.en: A prompt is typed and sent; a tree grows out of it level by level, each link running ahead with a glowing head and pulling its node out, while the camera pulls back from the words to the whole structure.
summary.zh: 打字并发送一句提示；一棵树从这句话里逐层长出，连线带发光头先到、把节点从端口拉出来，相机从字拉远到整棵结构。

fits: Generating structure from one sentence on a canvas: a plan, a diagram, a data model, an outline, a mind map.
notFor: More than seven nodes or three levels; trees meant to be studied in detail; an existing chart coming alive (this shows a structure being born).

overlaps.note: sources joined to one hub by running paths; tree-cascade grows a hierarchy from one root

intent.en: Show a structure being born from one sentence: links pull nodes out level by level, so the viewer reads 'it builds the whole structure from what I asked', with the order of growth carrying the sense of structure.
intent.zh: 表现一个结构从一句话里诞生：连线逐层把节点拉出来，观众读出“它从我这句话搭出了整个结构”，结构感来自生长的先后。

content.en: One prompt (en ≤ 40 chars, zh ≤ 16) and 3–7 nodes in up to three levels (root, children, grandchildren), each a title (en ≤ 13, zh ≤ 5) and a meta line (en ≤ 16, zh ≤ 7); an optional status line.
content.zh: 一句提示（英文 ≤ 40 字符，中文 ≤ 16 字）和 3–7 个节点、最多三层（根、子、孙），每个节点一个标题（英文 ≤ 13，中文 ≤ 5）和一行元信息（英文 ≤ 16，中文 ≤ 7）；可选一行状态。

fits.zh: 在画布上从一句话生成结构：计划、结构图、数据模型、大纲、脑图。

notFor.zh: 超过七个节点或三层；要细看的树；已有图表“活起来”（这里演的是结构的诞生）。

pairs.note: the quiet request before the tree grows

en: Grow level by level; all nodes at once loses the sense of structure, which comes from the order.
Centre the final breath on the tree's visual weight, not the frame centre, or it reads as a whole-screen zoom.
Do not use it to animate an existing chart; it means generation, not a diagram that is alive.
zh: 一层一层长；所有节点同时出现，结构感就没了，结构感来自先后。
成树后的呼吸以树的视觉重心为原点，不用画面中心，否则读作整屏缩放。
别拿它去演已有图表；它讲的是生成，不是图表在动。

upstream.name: 级联生成树
upstream.summary: prompt 逐字敲出（敲完描边变深确认）→根（深色）→2 子→4 孙逐层弹出，折角连线描线先行 8f，成树后整棵呼吸一拍
upstream.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"
